On a typical morning we read your account, and the welfare lead looked into it. You reported that your companion animal was not handled to the standard you were promised, that the journey caused distress, and that the incident was not explained to you in a clear or timely way.

We understand how upsetting that experience must have been. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk expects calm, humane handling at every stage of transport, and we rely on our handlers to use methods that protect both safety and welfare. Where a concern is raised, the senior coordinator reviews the full service record, speaks with the relevant teams, and checks whether our procedures were followed with care.

The review of your case found that the handling team did not maintain the level of communication we aim to provide, and this fell short of our service expectations. The matter has been referred for internal follow-up so that the sequence of events can be corrected and the staff involved can be reminded of the proper reporting standard. We also want to reassure you that companion animals are treated as a welfare priority, and that any future travel support will be planned with closer oversight.

<<FACT F119>>

We are sorry that the outcome left you with concern and frustration. If you choose to continue travelling with Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will make every reasonable effort to coordinate more closely with the operating team, confirm handling arrangements in advance, and keep communication direct and respectful throughout the journey. Your report has been logged for service improvement, and the senior coordinator will ensure that the review is not left unresolved. We appreciate that trust must be earned again, and we will act accordingly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
